_doc: A hand check of the decisions register's topic filter ('About:'), PL-17 of the 2026-10-31 audit: 200 resolutions drawn with random.Random(20261031).sample() from data/resolutions.json, each read by title and filed where a reader would look ('reader'). 'before' is the topic the rules gave it before the 2026-10-31 fixes, 'after' the topic they give now. The fixes were made from these same 200, so 'after' flatters the rules; a fresh sample is the honest next measure. r7 (2026-11-01): 16 of the 200 were retitled to what their minutes print (R-01); each was read again by its new title the same way, its Oct 31 reading kept under 'was', 'read' the day: the rules were not changed for them, and 14 of the 16 sit where a reader would look, so 'agree_after' is 198.
